location.address: 76 Ninth Avenue, Suite 313, New York, NY 10011

courses.name: Singing Voice 1 - HB Studio
courses.description: Beginner singing with Martha Bernard: breathing, vocal freedom and song practice with an accompanist. Open to all. Published fall 2026 section; confirm future enrollment with HB.

courses.name: Singing Voice 2 - HB Studio
courses.description: Martha Bernard leads intermediate singing technique and lyric interpretation with accompaniment. Level 2 placement is required. Published fall 2026 section; confirm future enrollment with HB.

courses.name: Voice for the Actor: Level 1 - The Barrow Group
courses.description: Spoken-voice training using breath, resonance and articulation exercises to develop a personal warm-up. For actors and other voice users; this is not a singing class. Confirm section format, tuition and enrollment with the school.

courses.name: Voice for the Actor: Level 2 - The Barrow Group
courses.description: Continuing spoken-voice study after Level 1, connecting movement and sound and refining an individual warm-up through feedback. Confirm placement, section format, tuition and enrollment with the school.

courses.name: Sound into Action: Voice & Monologue - Stella Adler
courses.description: Joe Goscinski combines spoken-voice exercises with classical and contemporary monologue practice. The published 2027 workshop requires an application and entrance interview for new students. Confirm dates and enrollment with the studio.

courses.name: Conservatory Voice - Atlantic Acting School
courses.description: Conservatory voice curriculum introducing Chuck Jones exercises, vocal care and text practice, with Fitzmaurice work at advanced levels. Part of an acting program requiring admission; not advertised as a separately bookable singing lesson. Ask admissions about program tuition and delivery.
